## Architecture notes omit prompt template base path, causing incorrect references

### Finding

During issue #4 (Initialize OpenCode Project Structure), the Coder created AGENTS.md by referencing `.github/notes/architecture.md`. The architecture notes describe `src/infrastructure/prompts/` as containing "PromptLoader, PromptHandler, PromptWrapper" (Python code) and separately list "131 prompt templates (Markdown)" with a category breakdown — but never state the actual base path (`src/application/strategies/*/prompts/`).

The Coder inferred that the templates were in `src/infrastructure/prompts/` and wrote that path into AGENTS.md. The Synthesized Review caught this as a unanimous warning, and it was fixed to `src/application/strategies/*/prompts/`. A second unanimous warning flagged a reference to the not-yet-created `src/tools/` directory, which was fixed with forward-reference language.

### Observation

When agents create documentation by referencing architecture notes, ambiguous or incomplete source material propagates errors downstream. The root cause is not agent behaviour — it's a gap in the source document. The architecture notes describe *what* exists (131 prompt templates, Python infrastructure handlers) but not *where* the templates live. Any agent reading the notes top-to-bottom would reasonably conclude the templates are in `src/infrastructure/prompts/`.

Additionally: the `development` branch did not exist and had to be created from `main`. This is a one-time setup issue that will not recur. The `scripts/git-safe-publish.sh` gap continues (already tracked in issue-1 reflection and `deferred.md`).

### Suggested Improvement

Add an explicit note to the "Prompt Template Categories" section in `.github/notes/architecture.md` clarifying that the 131 Markdown templates live in `src/application/strategies/*/prompts/`, while `src/infrastructure/prompts/` contains only the Python prompt-loading infrastructure.

### Action Taken

Applied: Added base path clarification to the "Prompt Template Categories" heading in `.github/notes/architecture.md`.
